title: Aaj ki economy mein Aparigraha kaise laagu karein?
hooks: GDP badh raha, par sukh kyun ghat raha?
Sabse bada economist tha ek Jain raja
Mahavir ne 2500 saal pehle bata diya tha
hook_why: Opens with a high-stakes claim connecting modern economic pain to ancient Jain wisdom, triggering curiosity immediately.
metaphor: Haath mein ret jitni zor se pakdo, utni hi tez nikal jaati hai

cast.Raja Megharath: Young king in ancient Indian royal attire, gold crown with simple design, white dhoti and angavastram, calm compassionate face, seated on carved sandstone throne in Jain palace with shikhara spires visible behind
cast.Jain Muni: Elderly monk in plain white unstitched cotton robes, carrying soft white rajoharan whisk broom, serene face with gentle smile, standing in palace courtyard with carved pillars

scenes.vo: GDP badh raha par sukh kyun ghat raha?
scenes.prompt: Modern smartphone screen showing breaking news ticker 'GDP Growth 7%' but person's reflection in screen looks worried, warm golden light, serene painterly style
scenes.title: AAJ KI HAALAT

scenes.vo: 2500 saal pehle ek raja ne jawab diya tha.
scenes.prompt: Ancient Jain palace courtyard with tall pointed shikhara spires, white marble floors, warm golden hour light, Raja Megharath seated on carved sandstone throne, Jain Muni standing before him with rajoharan
scenes.title: RAJA MEGHARATH

scenes.vo: Raja Megharath ke paas sab kuch tha.
scenes.prompt: Palace interior showing wealth: granaries full, jewel chests, horses, but king's face serene not proud, warm golden light on white marble pillars, carved lotus motifs on walls
scenes.title: SAMPATTI APAR

scenes.vo: Phir bhi Muni ne pucha: 'Rajan, kaun sa bojh sabse bhari?'
scenes.prompt: Close composition: Jain Muni in white robes with rajoharan gesturing gently toward king's heart, not the treasure, king listening with folded hands, carved sandstone pillars frame them, soft glow
scenes.title: MUNI KA PRASHNA

scenes.vo: Raja bola: 'Jo main rakhna chahta hoon, wahi bojh banta hai.'
scenes.prompt: King's hands open, jewels slipping through fingers like sand, turning into lotus petals as they fall, Muni nodding approvingly, palace shikhara in background, warm painterly light
scenes.title: RAJA KA GYAN

scenes.vo: Yahi hai Aparigraha: zaroorat lekin moh nahi.
scenes.prompt: White marble slab with golden Devanagari 'अपरिग्रह' glowing softly, lotus petals drifting around it, warm golden light, uncluttered serene composition
scenes.title: APARIGRAHA

scenes.vo: Aaj bhi wohi sawal: kitna kaafi hai?
scenes.prompt: Split composition: left side modern shopping bags piling up, right side single lotus flower in calm water, both under same warm golden sky, Jain temple shikhara faintly visible in distance connecting both eras
scenes.title: KITNA KAAFI

scenes.prompt: Jain Muni in white robes with rajoharan gesturing gently, king watching with folded hands, palace courtyard warm light, serene atmosphere
scenes.title: MUNI KA UPADESH

scenes.vo: Aaj hum bhi chhodo jo zaroori nahi hai.
scenes.prompt: Modern person opening hand, letting go of excess shopping bags, bags dissolve into light, Jain temple shikhara faint in background, golden hour
scenes.title: HUMARA KADAM

scenes.vo: Chhota sa badlav, badi shanti laata hai.
scenes.prompt: Split screen: left cluttered desk, right clean desk with single lotus, both under same warm light, subtle transition
scenes.title: BADLAV KA ASAR

scenes.prompt: Person's reflection in water changes from worried to calm as lotus blooms, ancient Jain temple spire mirrored, serene painterly style
scenes.title: SOCH KA KHEL

caption: GDP badh raha par sukh kyun ghat raha? 2500 saal pehle Raja Megharath ne bata diya tha: zaroorat lekin moh nahi. Aapke hisaab se kitna kaafi hai? #Aparigraha #JainWisdom #NavkarBhav

claims.claim: Aparigraha is the Jain principle of non-possessiveness, meaning keeping desires to what is necessary.
claims.basis: Wikipedia: Non-possession (aparigraha) is a religious tenet in Jainism meaning virtue of non-possessiveness, non-greediness; keeping desire for possessions to what is necessary.

claims.claim: Raja Megharath (Meghkumar) is a figure in Jain tradition who exemplified renunciation.
claims.basis: Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra by Hemachandra includes stories of kings like Megharath who practiced Jain principles.

claims.claim: Uttaradhyayana Sutra Chapter 29 contains teachings on renunciation and non-attachment.
claims.basis: Uttaradhyayana Sutra is a canonical Jain Agam text; Chapter 29 (or sections within) discusses monk's conduct and renunciation.

claims.claim: PM Modi referenced Samrat Samprati propagating aparigraha from the throne in 2026.
claims.basis: WION news 16 Nov 2026: PM Modi inaugurated Samrat Samprati Museum, stated Samrat Samprati propagated satya, asteya, and aparigraha with detachment.
